payload.summary: Medication pages show the maximum dose three times because the same content renders in three sections
payload.detail: Found in the 2026-09-27 phone-first design review (PR #3145 session). The same max-dose text appears in three sections of a medication page, which lengthens the page on a phone and risks the copies drifting apart. Clinical content decision for the owner: which section should own the max dose, and whether the others link to it. Not changed by that PR.
payload.source: Claude Code session 2026-09-27 phone-first design review (PR #3145)
